diagnostic_model.scan_rule: Verifier scans the complete supplied row sequence and accumulates every defined rejecting defect instead of returning on the first implementation-evaluated guard. A malformed row emits G_schema and suppresses only predicates whose operands are undefined for that row; scanning continues with later rows.
diagnostic_model.anchor: Each defect is anchored to the earliest input position whose fields suffice to witness it. Unary row guards anchor at that row; G_order and G_chain anchor at the later row of the offending pair.
diagnostic_model.selection_key: first_rejection = lexicographic min over (anchor_position, guard_rank). Input position, not evaluator visitation order, is primary; guard_rank breaks same-anchor ties.
diagnostic_model.implementation_order_invariance: For any permutation of pure guard evaluation order that yields the same set of defined defects, min under the fixed selection_key is identical. Therefore reported first_rejection is a function of certificate contents only.
diagnostic_model.semantic_scan_independence: Diagnostic rejection never short-circuits semantic evidence scanning. A later schema-complete H_d transition that validly sets d is still observed as fail_seen=true even when an earlier validation defect fixes first_rejection. FAIL evidence is retained for audit semantics although the malformed/rejected certificate is not accepted.
